name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1807: The dock collapse is a transform on dock-inner, and a transform does not change getBoundingClientRect height - so the measurer floor for a collapsed dock could never fire. --dock-h kept reporting the expanded height while the dock rendered as a 12px handle, and every consumer positioned against a dock that was not there. Pressing D has always done this. At 640x400 it threw the tray FABs to the top of the viewport under the claim bar.
